title: 5.4.10 Check: the flapping game
description: Eight multiple-choice questions on gravity and the flap, the scrolling world, timed spawning, removing what has left, scoring a pass once, and what a restart puts back. Checked instantly.

questions.question: Why does the flap write `bird.vel.y = -4` instead of `bird.vel.y -= 4`?
options: `-=` is not allowed on a sprite
Setting it gives the same flap size however fast the bird was falling
questions.explanation: Setting the speed makes every flap identical. Subtracting from a speed that is already large and downward only slows the fall.

questions.question: While the space bar is held, the bird climbs at one steady speed; let go and it falls. Which line was used?
questions.explanation: `kb.pressing` is true on every frame the key is held, so the speed is reset on every frame. `kb.presses` fires once per tap.

questions.question: In this game, what makes the bird look as though it is flying forward?
options: The pipes are given a leftward speed
questions.explanation: The bird's x never changes. The pipes slide left, which reads as forward motion.

questions.question: What does `if (frameCount % 90 === 0)` do?
options: Runs on every 90th frame, again and again
questions.explanation: `frameCount % 90` repeats 0 to 89, and it equals 0 once per cycle, so the test is true every 90 frames.

questions.question: Why does the loop that removes off-screen pipes count down from the end?
options: `splice` shifts later items down, and counting upward would skip one
Arrays can only be read backwards
questions.explanation: After `splice`, every later item moves down one place. Counting down, the items still to visit are never moved.

questions.question: A pipe has slid off the left edge. What must happen to it?
options: Its sprite is deleted and it is spliced out of the array
Its sprite is deleted; the array can keep it
It is spliced out of the array; the sprite can stay
questions.explanation: Deleting takes it off the screen. Splicing takes it out of the array. If only one is done, the other keeps pointing at something that is gone.

questions.question: What is the `passed` flag on each pipe for?
options: It makes sure each pipe adds to the score once, not on every frame
It marks the pipe as deleted
questions.explanation: Without it, `p.x < bird.x` stays true every frame after the pipe is behind the bird, and the score races, the same as in 5.3.5.

questions.question: What must a restart put back in this game, besides the bird and the score?
options: The pipes, the gravity and the flag
Nothing; the next frame fixes it
questions.explanation: Everything a round owns: the pipes are deleted and the array emptied, gravity goes back on, and the flag is set true again.
